base_segments.excerpt: Add AppleScript support: SDEF includes: - Standard Suite (use the base Standard Suite (e.g. from Safari app) (except application)) - SwiftTag Suite - add v : add one or more FLAC files to a editor window add list of file : the file(s) to add [to editor window] : the editor window of the added file(s) → track : reference to added track(s) - application n : The application program. - ELEMENTS - contains editor windows, settings - PROPERTIES - name (text, r/o) : The name of the application. - frontmost (boolean, r/o) : Is this the active application? - version (text, r/o) : The version number of the application. - RESPONDS TO - open - quit - editor window n: The main SwiftTag window. - ELEMENTS - contains tracks - PROPERTIES - id (text, r/o): The window UUID. - fingerprint (text, r/o): The tracks SHA256 hash. - document (document, r/o): The associated SwiftTag document. - RESPONDS TO - add - close - save - document n: A SwiftTag document. - ELEMENTS - contains tracks, swift tags - PROPERTIES - id (text, r/o): The document UUID - fingerprint (text, r/o): The document tracks SHA256 hash - URL (text, r/o): The document URL - RESPONDS TO - save - swift tag n: A SwiftTag document metadata
